title: Кібератака на державні організації України з використанням шкідливої програми Cobalt Strike Beacon (CERT-UA#4227)

entities.name: Диверсанти.rar
entities.gloss: A malicious RAR archive file used in an attack campaign.

entities.name: Диверсанти 21.03.rar
entities.gloss: A nested malicious RAR archive file containing an SFX archive.

entities.name: Диверсанти filercs.rar
entities.gloss: A self-extracting archive using a right-to-left override character in its name to mask its file extension.

entities.name: Thumbs.db
entities.gloss: A malicious VBScript file masquerading as a Windows thumbnail database file.

entities.name: dhdhk0k34.com
entities.gloss: A malicious .NET executable launched by a VBScript to infect the system with Cobalt Strike Beacon.

entities.name: Cobalt Strike Beacon
entities.gloss: A post-exploitation adversary emulation agent frequently used by threat actors for remote control.

entities.name: inject.exe
entities.gloss: An injector executable used to deploy malicious payloads.

entities.name: UAC-0057
entities.gloss: A threat group also known as UNC1151 or Ghostwriter.

entities.name: Skype.exe
entities.gloss: A malicious executable dropped to the public user directory during compromise.

entities.name: csbeacon.bin
entities.gloss: A payload binary file containing Cobalt Strike Beacon shellcode.

entities.name: ao3.hmgo.pw
entities.gloss: A fully qualified domain name used as malicious network infrastructure.

entities.name: hmgo.pw
entities.gloss: An internet domain used in cyberattack infrastructure.

entities.name: hXXps://ao3.hmgo[.]pw/tags/Akihabara@TODEEP/works
entities.gloss: A malicious URL associated with the attack infrastructure.

entities.name: hXXps://ao3.hmgo[.]pw/tags/Akihabara@TODEEP/works/update
entities.gloss: A malicious URL associated with command and control communication or payload delivery.

relations.head: Диверсанти filercs.rar
relations.evidence: архів містить документи та зображення приманки, а також VBScript-код (Thumbs.db)

relations.head: dhdhk0k34.com
relations.evidence: В результаті комп'ютер буде уражено шкідливою програмою Cobalt Strike Beacon

relations.head: UAC-0057
relations.evidence: специфічності VBScript-коду, з середнім рівнем впевненості асоційовано з діяльністю групи UAC-0057
